capabilities: Set custom icons for property entries
Load icons from online URLs, local vault or computer paths, and base64-encoded images
extras: README lists the three supported link types for icons but does not explain how to assign icons to specific properties in the settings UI; a Chinese introduction is available via the author's public channels.
problem: Obsidian properties all show the same default icons, so users cannot visually distinguish property types at a glance.
summary: Plugin that sets custom icons for property (metadata) entries, using online URLs, local file paths, or base64-encoded images.
